204| | `CODE_TUI_STATE_ROOT` | `~/.local/state/code-tui` | Alternative state root |
   205| 
   206| ### Verification goal
   207| 
   208| On startup the server picks a check command: `CODE_TUI_CHECK` if it is set, otherwise
   209| `bun run typecheck` when the workspace's `package.json` has a `typecheck` script, else
   210| `bun test` when it has a `test` script, else nothing. The worker passes it to the agent
   211| as a goal; when the check exits `0` the run stops with `VERIFIED` and lands as `done`
   212| with the label `verified: <check> passed`. Set `CODE_TUI_CHECK=` to opt out.
   213| 
   214| ## HTTP API
   215| 
   216| The server binds to `127.0.0.1` on a random port (written to `server.json`):
   217| 
   218| | Route | Meaning |
   219| |---|---|
   220| | `GET /` | Plain-text banner: version, workspace, state, port, model, key |
   221| | `GET /health` | `{ ok: true, ...ServerInfo, hasKey }` |
   222| | `GET /api/snapshot` | `{ type: "snapshot", server, tasks }` |
   223| | `POST /api/tasks` | `{ prompt }` → `201 { task }`; empty or >20000 chars is `400` |
   224| | `GET /api/tasks/:id` | `{ task }` |
   225| | `GET /api/tasks/:id/events?limit=600` | `{ events }` from the journal (limit clamped to 2000) |
   226| | `POST /api/tasks/:id/cancel` | Request cancellation, `{ task }` |

   234| 
   235| Each task's journal is append-only JSONL with `seq`, `ts`, `kind`, and kind-specific
   236| fields. Kinds: `queued`, `started`, `pid`, `cell.start`, `turn`, `log`, `stderr`,
   237| `error`, `final`, `finished`.

   299| ```
